statements.sql: SELECT table_name FROM duckdb_tables() WHERE NOT temporary AND NOT internal AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
PRAGMA table_info("orders")

SELECT constraint_type, constraint_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'orders'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
SELECT "order_id", "user_id", "price", "ts" FROM "orders" LIMIT 1000
PRAGMA table_info("users")

SELECT constraint_type, constraint_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'users'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
SELECT "user_id", "age", "country", "tier" FROM "users" LIMIT 1000

SELECT constraint_index, referenced_table,
       constraint_column_names, referenced_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'orders'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
  AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'

SELECT constraint_index, referenced_table,
       constraint_column_names, referenced_column_names
FROM duckdb_constraints()
WHERE table_name = 'users'
  AND database_name = current_database() AND schema_name = current_schema()
  AND constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'

SELECT 0 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "order_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "order_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "orders"
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS k, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT "user_id") AS d, COUNT(CASE WHEN "user_id" IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS z
FROM "users"
SELECT table_name, expressions FROM duckdb_indexes()

SELECT
  0 as table_index,
  MIN(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as min_date,
  MAX(CAST("ts" AS TIMESTAMP)) as max_date
FROM "orders"

SELECT "user_id", "tier"
FROM (SELECT * FROM "users"
WHERE "user_id" IS NOT NULL)
USING SAMPLE reservoir(10000 ROWS) REPEATABLE (42)
